newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet fuel little changed in slim trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet fuel little changed in slim trade.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices were little changed late Friday amid a slight drop in July NYMEX heating oil and stable differentials, with few deals spotted in slim trade ahead of the weekend.

Prompt Gulf Coast 54-grade jet was offered at 0.20 cent over July NYMEX, with 55-grade material selling for 0.45 cent over, players said. "There's a surplus of fuel, so there's not much upward pressure on diffs," one Gulf trader said.
New York Harbor 54-grade was offered for 1.65 cents over the screen, a tad firmer than Thursday diffs, with 55-grade pegged at 2.25 cents over, traders said.
